continuationGovernor.stopReason: Production evidence exposed two release-blocking workflow defects after the repeat-order lifecycle fix: the newest real PAID Issue exists canonically but an already-open Owner OS can remain stale because core panels fetch only on mount; and a same-browser repeat child does not inherit the parent's verified contact, forcing another OTP. Gmail evidence also proves identical OTP subjects collapse many different valid codes into one conversation, while the client discards safe server error reasons and reports every failure as a code mismatch. The architectural repair design is committed and self-reviewed; implementation is gated only by the required written-spec owner review.

rules: Treat feat/mystery-foundation as canonical until final release promotion
Use TDD RED before behavior changes
Require fresh CI, build, browser, production and database evidence before success claims
Browser navigation is never payment proof
Safepay PAID may be established by authenticated webhook truth or authoritative Reporter truth proving the immutable quote
New Safepay hosted checkout URLs must explicitly request webhook delivery with webhooks=true
Keep Reporter reconciliation as an independent payment-truth fallback even when webhooks are enabled
Never expose secrets, OTPs, session tokens, raw private answers, addresses or payout details
Never apply production database migrations without exact owner approval
Do not configure REFERRAL_ATTRIBUTION_SIGNING_KEY before migration 0029 is applied and verified
Keep Printful production confirmation disabled until its independent owner release gate
Do not create real charges solely for QA; use preview/fake payment paths
A paid Issue present in Neon but absent from Owner OS is a release blocker
